notes.title: Announcement of Service Suspension and Maintenance on February 17th
notes.notes:
Dear experience officer: 

In order to provide better and more stable services, "Girls on Campus, from Freshmen to Faculty, All Fall for Me!" will undergo server shutdown maintenance from 4:00 pm on February 17th, with an estimated maintenance time of 120 minutes. Login is not possible during maintenance. The specific opening time may be advanced or delayed according to the maintenance progress. Please arrange the experience time in advance for all experience officers~
